title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.18845v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. translated_title: 人类建造的最后一个遥感模型？将任意对地观测任务转化为递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 对地观测（EO）模型目前仍由人工构建。对于每个新任务，专家都需要设计训练方案并针对基准进行调优。我们证明这一流程可以交给智能体来完成。任何可验证的任务都可以被表示为一个执行框架和一个验证器，其中执行框架定义智能体可以使用什么，验证器定义什么算作成功。每个对地观测任务都可以变得可验证，方法包括使用带标签的基准、独立传感器、物理模型或对同一地点的重复观测。仅需这两个组件，一个通用的编程智能体就能构建对地观测模型，并在其自身输出上递归地改进它。长期以来被视为独立研究问题的各种设置，从少标签学习到跨域适应，都变成了对执行框架和验证器的选择。在涵盖光学、SAR和多光谱时序影像的六个对地观测基准上，输出范围从土地覆盖图和船舶实例到……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出将任意对地观测任务抽象为“执行框架+验证器”的形式，使通用编程智能体能够自动构建遥感模型并在自身输出上递归自我改进，有望终结由人类手工设计遥感模型的时代。
en_tdlr: This paper casts any Earth observation task as a harness-verifier pair, enabling a general-purpose coding agent to automatically build and recursively self-improve remote sensing models, potentially marking the last EO models ever built by humans.
